rows.ARS:
Orange-pink Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Satin Beauty
rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 2002).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2002 as 'Satin Beauty'.
rows.Bloom: Salmon-orange, ages to cream . None / no fragrance. Full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Medium, few or no prickles/thorns, upright.
